args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, 8 accepted, 0 flagged, 8 cleared (r01–r08).
Checks: all three passed on every run (rigid-body invariance 0.62–1.12 vs 2.0 %/h, closure 0.06–0.22 vs 1.0 px/h, plane sections 1.19–2.22 vs 3.25 %/h). No run used the width-free ratio.
Profiles: the centre strain-rate (REGR) peak is 53.02–53.09 %/h on every run, always at 421 µm from the tip. Growth-zone length is 674–695 µm. The largest flank difference is between -8.36 and -7.97 %/h, at 410–432 µm.
r05's flank-difference z of -2.96 is only 0.29 %/h from the median, because the batch spread is very small, so it was not treated as an outlier. r01 kept one remedy (frame registration on the non-growing tissue). That is the normal path to passing checks, and its summaries match the batch.
No flagged runs, so there is no shared pattern to report.
Note: r03, r04 and r07 have the same check values and summaries, and so do r02, r06 and r08. It is worth confirming that these are separate roots or time windows and not repeated inputs.
